description: Search the catalogue of 135 real websites clify can call (package registries, government data, science, news, jobs, weather, culture…). Pass a keyword query to get the best sites with their matching commands. Without a query it pages through the catalogue, one line per site ("name (category, commands): about"); filter with category. Start here.

limit.description: max sites (default 6 with a query, 40 per page without)

offset.description: skip this many sites when paging the catalogue (see nextPage)

query.description: what you need, e.g. "rust crate versions" or "weather forecast"

name: clify_sites
title: Find a clify site
